segments.context: isometric small flying craft navigates large stone/metal structures over brown ground/fog

visual_notes: Stylized nonhuman hovering craft, no person/anatomy targets. Large towers/rocks give navigation context and can occlude sections of craft; visible mask cannot recover hidden craft. Craft stays small near middle while environment changes; small scale alone is not low composition.
review_method: Direct current-agent vision; six clear overview frames plus both 40-frame timecoded sheets. No human labels or prior predictions read.
